The '''Alien Arms Bazaar''' was a weapons market located in the [[Wannschok Tenements]] in the [[Nikto Sector]] of the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. The [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolan]] [[Nurkolas]] operated his shop, [[Nurkolas Arms]], out of the bazaar, as did the merchant [[Gamoruk]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Alien Arms Bazaar appears as part of the Nikto Sector on Nar Shaddaa in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]].<ref name="TOR" />
